name: twilio
summary: Multi-tenant two-way SMS assistant. Hire it, connect your own Twilio number, and it answers text messages with conversation memory — your Twilio credentials stay under your account, released only to your own credential-proxy actor.

twilio_number.description: the hirer's Twilio phone number in E.164 (+1…) — inbound SMS to it route to this hire

proxy.description: hirer's deployed twiliorelay proxy actor address (0x…)

state_volume.description: per-hire CBFS state volume name (provisioned by the creator at connect time)

webhooks.description: Twilio Messaging webhook (all tenants share it; routing is by the destination number To). Set it as the 'A message comes in' webhook on your Twilio number.
webhooks.authentication: Twilio X-Twilio-Signature (HMAC-SHA1 over URL+sorted params), verified runner-side against YOUR Auth Token via your credential proxy (CIP-24 §5.5); the listed actor never holds it.

hirer_setup.description: Post-hire onboarding (scripted by connect-workspace.sh): provision a Twilio number and a scoped Standard API Key, store TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN + TWILIO_API_BASIC (base64 of 'SKsid:secret') as CBSS secrets under your account, deploy your twiliorelay proxy (manifest names exactly those two keys), ACL both secrets to the proxy, then call connect_number.
